stories.title: Facade Input/Output Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define the canonical request and response schemas for Evaluate Care Facade covering clinical trials search and provider detail lookup, ensuring consistent structure across domains and compatibility with tool_router.

stories.title: Core Orchestration Logic for Trials and Provider Detail
stories.description: Implement facade orchestration logic that routes requests to clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service, aggregates results, and normalizes outputs into a unified response structure.

stories.title: Tool Router Integration for Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate the Evaluate Care Facade with tool_router to expose facade capabilities as callable tools, including validation, allowlist registration, and structured tool responses.

stories.title: Facade Error Handling and Response Normalization
stories.description: Implement consistent error handling, fallback behavior, and response normalization across clinical trials and provider detail flows to ensure stable outputs for UI and LLM consumption.

stories.title: Facade Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating facade orchestration, including clinical trials queries, provider detail lookup, tool_router invocation, and error scenarios.
